name: Craft CMS
description: Craft CMS is a content-first content management system built by Pixel & Tonic that prioritizes flexible content modeling over predetermined structures, for both coupled and headless implementations.
best_for: Agencies and developers building multi-site or e-commerce projects who want flexible content modeling without being locked into a rigid page structure.
features: Customizable field types and flexible content modeling
Multi-site support with unlimited localization, translated into 25 languages in the control panel
Twig templating for coupled sites and a self-generating GraphQL API for decoupled apps
Extensible plugin framework with a built-in Plugin Store
Third-party integrations including Salesforce, Mailchimp, and HubSpot

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.description: The world's most widely used CMS, powering everything from blogs to large-scale websites with a vast plugin and theme ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and businesses of all sizes needing a flexible, widely supported CMS

alternatives.name: Webflow
alternatives.description: A visual web design and CMS platform that lets designers build production-ready, responsive sites without writing code.
alternatives.best_for: Designers wanting full visual control without hand-coding

alternatives.name: Drupal
alternatives.description: An open-source, API-first CMS for building structured, composable digital experiences across websites and channels.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises and institutions needing a highly customizable, secure CMS

tiers.name: Solo
tiers.notes: Free forever self-hosted; one user account.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Per project; includes one year of updates, then $99/year for updates. Free when hosted on Craft Cloud.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Per project; includes one year of updates, then $99/year for updates. Free when hosted on Craft Cloud.

tiers.name: Craft Cloud Team
tiers.notes: $120/month per project when paid annually; includes Craft Team and managed hosting.

tiers.name: Craft Cloud Pro
tiers.notes: $240/month per project when paid annually; includes Craft Pro and managed hosting.

cons: Self-hosted Team and Pro licenses include only one year of updates; continued updates/support cost $99/year per project after that, and commercial plugins can add separate costs.

Craft Cloud is a separate recurring hosting expense ($120/month Team or $240/month Pro when paid annually), so a hosted deployment has very different economics from the one-time self-hosted CMS license.
